doc.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022

chapter: Working with Al Grey and Diva
title: Al Grey wanting her to play tenor
summary: Grey asked her, an alto player, to switch to tenor as Diva was forming; she overcame her intimidation.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Does it make you play better or differently?
What? Because I played with him?
I mean when you were playing with him, did you feel like you changed your own personal style somewhat to —

But he wanted me to play tenor because I was an alto player, and I wasn’t playing tenor, and this was right around the same time that that all-female big band Diva was forming, and they wanted me to play tenor. And I’d always been too intimidated by all my great tenor player heroes — to play the tenor. But I thought if people are going to pay me to do this, I’m good. Can you hold on for one second?
